- **rule** `cli/write-every-published-text-person-who`: Write every published text for the person who reads it cold: a release's notes are the version's own section of cli/CHANGELOG.md, saying what was wrong or missing, what it does now and what the reader has to do. Never publish generated notes, a list of pull request titles, a username or an internal name; the same standard as a commit message and a pull request description applies to anything that leaves the repository.
